meta.title: BMW generation database
meta.statusRules: current = still in production (productionEnd null); historical = ended before 1990; discontinued = ended 1990 or later.
meta.classicRule: classic = production ended in 1995 or earlier.
accuracyNotes: Years are worldwide production years from memory of public reference sources; no record was checked against BMW Group Classic in this build.
Records with a non-null 'uncertain' field have a date, code or link that could not be confirmed and should be checked.
Every Wikipedia URL has wikipediaVerified=false until tools/check-wikipedia.js is run from a machine with internet access.
Body-specific chassis codes (E91, E92, E93...) point to the shared family article where Wikipedia has no per-body article.
Pre-war and post-war historic records use marketing designations, not chassis codes (codeType says which).
